KEY PRODUCT FEATURES:
• 8 Innistrad: Crimson Vow MTG Set Boosters
• 1 Collector Booster full of rares, foils, and special card treatments
• 1 foil alt-art promo card
• 40 basic land cards (20 foil + 20 nonfoil)
• Exclusive Spindown life counter + foil card storage box
• Invite an honored guest to a sumptuous vampire wedding on the gothic horror plane of Innistrad

DESCRIPTION:
The Innistrad: Crimson Vow Gift Bundle contains 8 Innistrad: Crimson Vow Set Boosters, 1 Innistrad: Crimson Vow Collector Booster, 40 basic lands (20 traditional foils and 20 nonfoils), 1 traditional foil alt-art promo card, 1 exclusive oversized Spindown life counter, 1 card storage box, and 2 reference cards. Collector Boosters are packed with the coolest cards from Innistrad: Crimson Vow. Each booster contains 15 Magic: The Gathering cards and 1 traditional foil double-sided token, with a total of 5 Rare and/or Mythic Rare cards, and a total of 8 cards with stunning special treatments—including Showcase, Borderless, and Extended-Art cards. The best boosters to open just for fun— each Innistrad: Crimson Vow Set Booster contains 12 Magic cards, 1 Art Card, and 1 token, ad card, Helper card, or special card from Magic's history (a card from "The List"), with a combination of 1–4 Rares and/or Mythic Rares, 2–7 Uncommons, 3–8 Commons, and 1 Land card in every pack.
